mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_task(record_type,task_domain,rule_id,test_mode,task_key,task_status,domain_status,matched,input_snapshot,output_snapshot,snapshot_retention_until,sample_start,sample_end,sample_size,external_notifications_sent,user_id,completed_at) VALUES('ALERT_RULE_TEST','ALERT_GOVERNANCE',#{row.ruleId},#{row.mode},CONCAT('ALERT_RULE_TEST:',UUID()),'COMPLETED','COMPLETED',#{row.matched},CAST(#{row.inputJson} AS JSON),CAST(#{row.resultJson} AS JSON),DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL 365 DAY),#{row.start},#{row.end},#{row.sampleSize},0,#{row.actor},NOW(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_task SET output_snapshot=CAST(#{result} AS JSON) WHERE id=#{id} AND record_type='ALERT_RULE_TEST'
mapper.select: SELECT id raw_id,COALESCE(legacy_source_id,id) id,parent_task_id parent_id,rule_id,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(input_snapshot,'$.ruleCode')) rule_code,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(input_snapshot,'$.title')) title,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(input_snapshot,'$.severity')) severity,domain_status status,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(input_snapshot,'$.notificationChannel')) notification_channel,CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(input_snapshot,'$.productionImpact')) AS UNSIGNED) production_impact,created_at,user_id FROM t_ai_task WHERE record_type='ALERT_DRILL' AND id<#{before} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id,COALESCE(legacy_source_id,id) display_id FROM t_ai_task WHERE id IN #{id}

SELECT id,domain_status status,CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(input_snapshot,'$.productionImpact')) AS UNSIGNED) production_impact,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(input_snapshot,'$.notificationChannel')) notification_channel FROM t_ai_task WHERE record_type='ALERT_DRILL' AND COALESCE(legacy_source_id,id)=#{displayId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_task SET domain_status=#{target},task_status=IF(#{target}='RESOLVED','COMPLETED','RUNNING'),output_snapshot=JSON_OBJECT('lastAction',#{target},'reason',#{reason},'actor',#{actor},'at',NOW(3)),completed_at=IF(#{target}='RESOLVED',NOW(3),NULL) WHERE id=#{id} AND record_type='ALERT_DRILL'
